---
title: Quickstart
description: Install the CLI, log in, and receive your team's skills.
---

Five minutes, start to finish. Every command below is copy-pasteable.

## Install and log in

<Steps>
  <Step title="Install the CLI">
    No sudo — the binary lands in `~/.local/bin`.

    ```sh
    curl -fsSL https://topos.sh/install | sh
    ```
  </Step>

  <Step title="Log in to your workspace">
    ```sh title="Log in"
    topos login https://topos.sh/acme
    ```

    A signed-in human approves the login once in a browser.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Warning>
  Logging in is the acceptance step: from then on updates arrive silently. Leaving is
  always possible — `topos logout` ends the session and the bytes stay put.
</Warning>

## Check what landed

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Agent">
    ```sh
    topos status --json
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Human">
    ```sh
    topos status
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

The table below is the shape you should expect.

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Reference | The winning reference for a bundle |
| Scope | Where the bundle applies |

<Tip>
  Run `topos` with no arguments for the same snapshot.
</Tip>
